confirmedControls: Legal, privacy, provider-use, source-use and EU AI Act accountability is split into typed owner groups; every applicable approval is required and every value remains unresolved and fail closed.
Evidence outputs require immutable append-only hash-bound envelopes, retention and legal-hold references, and separate writer and independent-verifier authority.

Rollback is stop/disable plus append-only forward correction; prior bytes and evidence are preserved and destructive cleanup requires separate explicit Phase 7 human authorisation bound to exact paths, hashes, identity and abort conditions.
MP-01 through MP-08 bind literal working directories, repository/path assertions, traversal prevention and local-only guards prohibiting Azure sign-in, what-if and deployment.
The R2 manifest conforms to the AFF phase-hash schema, includes model-plan revision 111, generation time and an allowed role for each of six non-manifest artifacts.
MP-07 carries the approved Phase 3 evaluation routes, primary/recovery parity, EVAL-001 through EVAL-010 and all twelve immutable security promotion gates.

The text-embedding-3-large supporting deployment is present with DataZoneStandard, NoAutoUpgrade, owner-supplied version and identifiers, dimensions/chunking evidence and recovery parity; no value is invented.
MP-08 truthfully targets the future Phase 5 approval record with a null hash, REQUIRED_AFTER_PHASE_5_APPROVAL state, PENDING_BLOCKED state and fail-closed behaviour.
The candidate preserves the exact non-deployment boundary and makes no Azure, benchmark, security-gate, runtime, quota, compliance-readiness or production claim.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: MP-08 targets approvals/5/stratton-phase-5-cc-002-approval-1.json, uses sha256 null, REQUIRED_AFTER_PHASE_5_APPROVAL, PENDING_BLOCKED and failClosed true.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: All six inputs use the prescribed accountable owner groups and require all applicable approvals while remaining unresolved and fail closed.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: Typed owner groups now include General Counsel, DPO, Source Owners, AI Governance, Compliance, Head of AI Governance, CISO and the relevant technical owners.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: Every work package and the global catalogue bind immutable append-only hash custody, envelope fields, retention/legal hold references and independent verifier separation.

priorFindingDisposition.title: Rollback permitted destructive or mutable actions without a boundary
priorFindingDisposition.evidence: Every rollback contract is stop/disable and append-only forward correction, preserves prior evidence and requires separate explicit Phase 7 authority for destructive cleanup.

priorFindingDisposition.title: Markdown owner-input delimiter had the wrong cell count
priorFindingDisposition.evidence: The R2 Markdown owner-input delimiter has seven cells and Markdown/HTML table and semantic parity is PASS.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: MP-01..MP-07 bind cases/Stratton-Europe-Captital/5-coding-r4; MP-08 binds REPOSITORY_ROOT; literal path, traversal and no-Azure guards are present.

priorFindingDisposition.evidence: R2 records bind the independent verification receipt; the original contract prerequisite, R2 self-test, R2 contract and raw-byte hash checks are PASS.

verdictRationale: All prior Critical/Major/Minor findings are addressed in the unchanged R2 candidate. Remaining owner evidence and the Phase 5 approval gate are explicit, unresolved and fail closed. No compliance, readiness, benchmark, runtime, deployment or approval claim is made.
requiredAction: Preserve the exact R2 bytes, obtain AFF-A review against the same manifest, then present both reviews and residual gaps for an explicit human decision. Do not approve, promote, deploy, test or enter Phase 7 on the basis of this review.
